description: ![Seed Protect cover image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/seed-protect/main/.modcompiler-art/description-image.webp) Seed Protect stops farmland trampling by players and mobs, so your crops never get uprooted accidentally. Install and forget — no commands, no items, no configuration. [](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=fabric) [](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=forge) [](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=neoforge) [](https://modrinth.com/mod/seed-protect/versions?l=quilt) [](https://ko-fi.com/U2P522M1IW) ## 📦 Installation 1. Make sure you have the correct mod loader installed: **Fabric**, **Forge**, or **NeoForge**. 2. Place the `seedprotect-.jar` file into the `mods` folder. - For **single‑player** or **LAN** games, put it in your client’s `.minecraft/mods` folder. - For **dedicated servers**, install on the server only; clients do not need the mod. 3. Start the game or server. The mod activates automatically — no further steps. ## ✨ Features - **Trampling protection** — farmland never reverts to dirt when a player or mob walks or falls on it, so your crops stay rooted. - **Jump‑safe crops** — no more losing newly planted seeds because you accidentally jumped nearby. - **Mob‑proof fields** — animals, villagers, zombies, and other creatures can wander through your farmland without uprooting anything. - **Works instantly** — no items, commands, or config files needed. Install and you’re done. - **Fall damage untouched** — jumping on farmland still hurts as in vanilla; only the dirt conversion is blocked. - **Server‑friendly** — for dedicated servers, only the server needs the mod; clients can join without it. The Fabric variant uses a common mixin that works on both sides seamlessly. - **Startup greeting** — prints a mod info card in the log on launch, crediting the author and contributor. ![Jumping on wheat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d9271536132c7e47a3a4ca3249f7f425173e616.png) Even after a heavy landing, the wheat survives. ## 🧩 Compatibility | Minecraft | Fabric | Forge | NeoForge | |-----------|--------|-------|----------| | 1.20.1 | ✅ | ✅ | — | | 1.21.1 | ✅ | — | ✅ | | 1.21.11 | ✅ | — | — | | 26.1.2 | ✅ | — | — | **Dependencies:** None. No other mods are required. **Known incompatibilities:** None. Works alongside any mod that doesn’t drastically alter farmland mechanics. ## ❓ FAQ **Does this need to be installed on the server?** Yes. On dedicated servers, only the server needs Seed Protect; clients can join without it. For single‑player, place it in your client mods folder — the integrated server runs there. **Does this prevent fall damage?** No. Only the farmland‑to‑dirt conversion is stopped. Entities still take full fall damage when landing on farmland. **Will it break my existing farms?** No. Existing farmland and crops remain unchanged. The mod simply prevents new trampling. **Is this compatible with mods that add new crops?** Yes, as long as those crops use vanilla farmland. The trample event / mixin is cancelled globally. **Where do I report bugs?** Please open an issue on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/ModItamio/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aseedprotect) and include your Minecraft version, mod loader, and any crash logs. ## 🐛 Reporting Issues Found a problem? Let us know on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/ModItamio/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aseedprotect). Include your Minecraft version, mod loader, and a log file so we can help quickly. ## 💖 Support the Project Seed Protect is a free and open‑source mod maintained by **Itamio** with contributions from **Asd1281yss**. If you’d like to support development, you can buy us a coffee: [](https://ko-fi.com/U2P522M1IW) ## 📝 License & Modpacks Licensed under **MIT**. You are free to include this mod in any Modrinth or CurseForge‑hosted modpack without asking permission. Do not redistribute the jar file elsewhere.
